title: bloodcellai-detect: rule-based annotation-format and role detection for blood-cell imaging datasets
description: Python package containing the frozen format/role detector v1.4 used in the accompanying manuscript, an experimental v1.5 with directory- and pair-based segmentation evidence, the ground-truth locking and E1 audit tooling (Wilson confidence intervals, role confusion matrix, six-type mutation stress test), tests built from synthetic dataset layouts, and example ground-truth tables. No dataset images are included.
